title: ART IN THE PARK

PRESS RELEASE FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

Date: June 28, 2022

Submitted by Michael Rudden, President

RE:  Guild of Harwich Artists – Mondays Art-in-the-Park Starts July 4th

The Guild of Harwich Artists resumes their 42-year tradition of Monday art  shows in Doane Park, (Post Office Square) in Harwich Port.  Artworks include traditional paintings in a variety of mediums along with juried fine crafts. The season starts July 4thand runs through September 19th; weather permitting.  The Guild’s Art Gallery, 551 Main Street, is open daily 11am to 4pm and showcases 24 member artists in a variety of mediums.  Public parking is available across the street.

Submitted by Michael Rudden, msrarch@gmail.com, 617.851-3960
